title: Bioluminescent fish found at 4,000 m
bengaliTitle: ৪,০০০ মিটারের গভীরতায় জ্যোতির্ময় মাছ পাওয়া গেছে
excerpt: A new species of lanternfish was recorded during a deep-sea expedition in the Pacific.
content: A new species of lanternfish was recorded during a deep-sea expedition in the Pacific Ocean at a depth of 4,000 meters. The discovery highlights how much remains unknown about deep-sea biodiversity. The species exhibits bioluminescent patterns not previously documented in the Myctophidae family.

title: Tiger census shows population growth
bengaliTitle: বাঘ গণনা জনসংখ্যা বৃদ্ধি দেখা দেয়
excerpt: The latest national survey reports a steady rise in wild tiger numbers across reserves.
content: The latest national tiger census reports a steady rise in wild tiger numbers across reserves in India. The survey, conducted using camera traps and genetic sampling, indicates continued recovery of tiger populations in key landscapes. This marks the fourth cycle of the quadrennial All India Tiger Estimation.

title: Frog species rediscovered after 20 years
excerpt: The elusive mountain frog was spotted in a remote cloud forest by a survey team.
content: The elusive mountain frog, not seen for 20 years, was spotted in a remote cloud forest by a survey team. The rediscovery provides hope for other 'lost' amphibian species and highlights the importance of continued field surveys in biodiversity hotspots.
